lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a regular grid-like pattern posterior to the gills, extending toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a matrix of discrete anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges along the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the upper edge and lower intensity in the shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small high-luminance blobs irregularly scattered within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct elongated high-luminance features consistent with attached organisms (e.g., remoras) located on the dorsal midline anterior to the first dorsal fin and near the pectoral fin attachment.
